observation.visible_scene: A sunset beach view: a low sun on the horizon, an orange cloud band, a large ship silhouette offshore to the left, and waves with foam washing over wet sand in the foreground.
visible_changes: Comparing first and last frames, the ship remains left of the sun and the horizon/cloud arrangement stays broadly similar; the main change is in the foreground foam and reflections.
The white foam line repeatedly changes shape, length, and position, indicating ongoing wave movement; it is already moving at the start and still moving at the end.
The foam band changes extent and breaks into patches rather than simply translating as a rigid line.
The orange reflected light on the water and wet sand shifts and deforms as the surface moves; this is a reflection, not a separate object.
A small green lens-flare spot remains near the lower center, changing only slightly in position relative to the foam.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the wave pattern does before the excerpt begins or after it ends.
Whether any slight apparent horizon shift is handheld motion, camera drift, or unrelated to the scene.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is uncertain because the background remains largely unchanged.
Subtle cloud or ship movement cannot be separated from framing changes.
The green spot is likely a lens artifact rather than a physical object in the scene.
